desc: GitHub #60: a Switch Pro Controller (a virtual one, 057E:2009) as player 1 on a fresh user folder: the game's A, B, X and Y are on the buttons printed A, B, X and Y (its right, bottom, top and left ones), the page's defaults the same, the menus' confirm its A; the prompts draw those letters (TTYD_PADBIND_TEST=switch:attach)
log_must: ^\[bindings\] .*\(057e_2009, player \d\): A, B, X and Y put on their printed letters$
^\[padbind\] switch:attach: SDL type \d+, player 1 yes; confirm A, back B, third Y$
^\[padbind\] switch:attach: the game's A on A, B on B, X on X, Y on Y; defaults A A, B B, X X, Y Y$
^\[padbind\] Start menu pages: the game's A->0100 B->0200 X->0400 Y->0800
log_must_not: left as the player has them
